correctness.rationale: For each j, carry behavior proves consecutive ones iff j=4^t−1, including j=0. The two greedy initial arches are 110|110; all further complete arches carry one 1, apart from a single uncompleted 1 precisely at N=4^t+1, t≥2. Greedy binary arch count equals scattered-subsequence universality index in both directions. Four-state digit counting gives S(2^k)=F_(k+2). Hence the N≥6 formula and its dyadic specialization follow for infinitely many N. Independent direct digit/greedy computations checked N=6..4096 and small exhaustive target subsequences; finite tests are corroboration only.
